```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)  
itpc <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/Destrieux_final_itpc.csv")) |>
  dplyr::filter(type %in% c("prestim_itpc", "stim_itpc")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    S = dplyr::case_when(
      type == "prestim_itpc" ~ "prestim",
      type == "stim_itpc" ~ "stim",
      TRUE ~ type
    ),
    itpc = value
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(subject, roi, P, T, S, itpc) |>
  dplyr::distinct() #|>
#  dplyr::filter(P == "pre")

head(itpc)

p_halfeye <- ggplot(itpc, aes(y = S, x = itpc, fill = S)) +
  stat_halfeye(point_interval = median_qi,
               .width = c(0.50, 0.80, 0.95),
               adjust = 0.7, slab_alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Half-eye: distribution and quantile intervals", x = "ITPC", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p_halfeye 
```
I have decided to average condition to get 1 observation per subject, below I am preparing data to be used in the RBA

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# (Optional but safe) collapse duplicates first
itpc_avg <- itpc %>%
  group_by(subject, roi, S) %>%
  summarise(itpc = mean(itpc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Wide format: one row per subject × roi × T
itpc_wide <- itpc_avg %>%
  mutate(S = factor(S, levels = c("prestim", "stim"))) %>%  # ensure column order
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = S,
    values_from = itpc
  ) %>%
  # compute differences
  mutate(
    diff_itpc = stim - prestim,                      # absolute difference
  )

# If you want to drop rows missing either condition:
itpc_wide <- itpc_wide %>% tidyr::drop_na(prestim, stim)

itpc_wide %>% glimpse()
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# assumes you already have: itpc_avg with columns: subject, roi, S, itpc

itpc_rba_long <- itpc_avg %>%
  mutate(
    Cond = factor(S, levels = c("prestim","stim"))
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Subj = subject,
    ROI  = roi,
    Cond,
    Y    = itpc
  ) %>%itpc
  arrange(Subj, ROI, Cond) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Y)

write.table(
  itpc_rba_long,
  file = "itpc_rba_long.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "NA"
)
```



```{r}
# assumes you already have: itpc_wide with columns: subject, roi, prestim, stim
itpc_rba_diff <- itpc_wide %>%
  transmute(
    Subj = subject,
    ROI  = roi,
    Y    = stim - prestim
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Y)

write.table(
  itpc_rba_diff,
  file = "itpc_rba_diff.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "NA"
)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# 1) Average within subject × roi (collapse over T)
per_subject_roi <- itpc_wide %>%
  group_by(subject, roi) %>%
  summarise(diff_itpc_mean_T = mean(diff_itpc, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```


```{r}
read.delim("itpc_rba_long.tsv") %>% dplyr::glimpse()
read.delim("itpc_rba_diff.tsv") %>% dplyr::glimpse()
```
```{r}
# 0) sanity checks
stopifnot(file.exists("itpc_rba_diff.tsv"))     # Subj ROI Y
system("RBA -help | head -n 5")                 # confirm it's on PATH

# 1) run RBA (blocking; prints to the notebook)
cmd <- paste(
  "RBA",
  "-prefix itpc_diff_rba",
  "-chains 4",
  "-iterations 2000",
  "-model 1",
  "-EOI 'Intercept'",
  " -ridgePlot 10 8 ",
  "-distY 'student'",          # robust if your Y has outliers
  "-dataTable itpc_rba_diff.tsv"
)
status <- system(cmd)

# 2) read results back into R
res <- read.delim("itpc_diff_rba.txt", comment.char = "#")
head(res)
```

# Not needed part


```{r}


# 2) Summarise across subjects for each roi
summary_roi <- per_subject_roi %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_diff = mean(diff_itpc_mean_T, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd        = sd(diff_itpc_mean_T, na.rm = TRUE),
    se        = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_low    = mean_diff + qt(0.025, df = n - 1) * se,
    ci_high   = mean_diff + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ci_95 = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", ci_low, ci_high)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_diff))

# 3) GT table
summary_roi %>%
  select(roi, mean_diff, se, ci_95, n) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "roi") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**diff_itpc averaged across subjects, by ROI**"),
    subtitle = "Mean(stim − prestim) with SE and 95% CI; per-subject average over T first"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    mean_diff = "Mean diff_itpc",
    se        = "SE",
    ci_95     = "95% CI",
    n         = "N (subjects)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_diff, se), decimals = 3) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = list(cell_text(weight = "bold")),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(220))
```

# just comparing the conditions

```{r}
library(brms)
rstan::rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Example for S == "prestim"
itpc_prestim <- itpc %>%
  dplyr::filter(S == "prestim")

# brms model
fit_prestim <- brm(
  itpc ~ T * P + (1|subject) + (1 + T*P|roi), 
  data = itpc_prestim,
  family = Beta(),  # ITPC is [0,1]; use Beta regression
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 10000
)
```
```{r}
ranef(fit_prestim)$roi  # ROI-specific deviations from global effect
library(emmeans)
emmeans(fit_prestim, ~ T*P, type = "response")
```
  
```{r}
# main effects and interactions
contrast(emmeans(fit_prestim, ~ T*P), method = "pairwise")

# or specify hypotheses
hypothesis(fit_prestim, "Treal:Ppost - Tsham:Ppost > 0")
```
